assets.gate_reason: S6 Eruan palm: one native-alpha palm-tree board prop in the style of the accepted board trees. The exporter composites it over the existing beach sand for every PALMTREE1-20 cell. Identity and rule contract recorded before generation (render_evidence). No waiver.
assets.scope: Eruan (eruan) L1-3 only: sand.lua PALMTREE and its nice_tiler variants PALMTREE1-20, the blocking palms of the desert forest generator and the L3 static map.

references.note: Native desert palm: a slim curved ringed trunk with a crown of long arching green fronds. Keep this palm identity; make it a sturdier, fuller board piece.

Accepted board tree master (its recoloured crops are the South Beach and Caldera board trees): painted tabletop finish, soft upper-left light, readable dark canopy mass, trunk and roots on a small patch of ground. Use only its finish and lighting; the palm has a completely different shape.
Accepted board tree prop with generous transparent margins round a centred tree; match these margins, not its shape or palette.

grid_contract.sight: Blocks line of sight; does not block sense or ESP.
grid_contract.interaction: Diggable into sand by the native dig rule; no door, no transition.
grid_contract.export: Deterministic exporter composites the prop, cell-filling, over the existing board beach sand with the ground outside the crown shaded; plain and mirrored variants x 2 parities of 128px tiles.

prompt_fields.subject: A SINGLE desert date palm tree: a sturdy, slightly leaning ringed trunk with a rough diamond bark pattern, topped by a full, dense crown of long arching feathered green fronds spreading out in every direction, a few hanging dry brown fronds and a small cluster of dates under the crown, the trunk rising from a low mound of pale sand with a few roots.
prompt_fields.palette: Deep saturated palm green fronds with darker olive-green shadows and a few dry tan-brown fronds; warm grey-brown trunk; pale sand mound at the base. The crown is the darkest, largest mass; nothing bright neon green or yellow.
prompt_fields.contrast: At 48 pixels it must read as a palm tree (radiating fronds, bare trunk) that blocks the cell: a dark green crown clearly darker than the pale tan beach sand around it, and clearly different from a broad-leaved oak, a pine or a bush.
prompt_fields.composition: One whole palm tree in overhead three-quarter tabletop view, placed in the exact CENTRE of a mostly empty transparent canvas. The tree occupies ONLY the middle 76% of the canvas width: the crown's leftmost frond tip about 12% from the left edge and its rightmost tip about 12% from the right edge, with fully transparent empty space on both sides. Crown top about 12% from the top edge, sand mound resting at about 88% of the image height. Nothing, not a frond tip, root or shadow, extends into the outer 10% band on any side. Transparent corners. No cut-off fronds.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Eruan palm tree: blocks movement and sight. No fruit pickup, water, hazard, character, sign or other decoration.
